evidence.notes: Local Flow.Interview creates a deterministic interview DTO from flow name and input variables; it does not execute Flow metadata.
Namespace overload preserves the local interview DTO shape.
start rejects a missing Flow definition with a catchable exception; declarative Flow execution is not claimed.
getVariableValue reads the deterministic input-variable map.

name: core-runtime-flow-interview-runtime-contracts
salesforceExclusionReason: The fixture intentionally names LocalFlow without deploying a Flow definition; it proves Glade's local interview DTO and missing-definition rejection, not hosted Flow execution.

source.content: @isTest private class FlowInterviewRuntimeContractsTest { @isTest static void localInterviewDtoKeepsInputs() { Map<String,Object> inputs = new Map<String,Object>{ 'answer' => 42, 'name' => 'Trail' }; Flow.Interview interview = Flow.Interview.createInterview('LocalFlow', inputs); Boolean caught = false; try { interview.start(); } catch (FlowException e) { caught = true; System.assert(e.getMessage().contains('LocalFlow')); } System.assert(caught); System.assertEquals(42, interview.getVariableValue('answer')); System.assertEquals(null, interview.getVariableValue('missing')); Flow.Interview namespaced = Flow.Interview.createInterview('pkg', 'LocalFlow', inputs); System.assertEquals('Trail', namespaced.getVariableValue('name')); } }
